summary.what_it_does: The page describes a generator that takes one clear full-body adult photo and produces a roughly 15–17 second 9:16 MP4 of a Tecktonik-style dance on a red outdoor stage with crowd phones. Output includes original AI ambient audio, and the page says no captions or watermarks are intended. Sample clips on the page range from about 10 to 30 seconds. Pricing is per credit pack: $6.90 for one 480p Standard video, $9.90 for one 720p HD video, and larger HD bundles up to $49.90 for eight. Failed generations return credits automatically, and renders usually take a few minutes. The page states it is an independent fan tool, not affiliated with @cheba_man, ARTBAT, Benny Benassi, or the original creator.
